title: Avrocar as cover for Roswell craft work and Nazi scientist recruitment

plain: The Avrocar, a saucer-shaped aircraft built in Canada in the postwar years, was probably a cover for something deeper, according to Michels, who gives this as his own view. He points to the rumours that the craft said to have crashed at Roswell, New Mexico, in 1947 was taken to Wright Field, an Air Force airfield in Ohio. In his telling, the saucer project would have hidden work on that craft and the recruitment of German scientists who had worked for the Nazis.
